description: This file is a Perl module defining package metadata parsing functions, including parsing package and target metadata, managing package categories, and handling user/group IDs.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiline string from file handle until @@ marker, prepending optional prefix to each line.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Replaces certain characters in a string with underscores for configuration string formatting.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses user or group specification strings, validates IDs, and updates corresponding hashes.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Parses target metadata from a file, extracting target properties, profiles, and subtargets.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Clears all package-related global hashes and arrays.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses package metadata from a file, extracting package details, dependencies, categories, and other attributes.
